transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm... well, I suppose I'm here because of work. I do environmental modeling. Lately, I've been noticing some things with a contract I'm leading. 

It's the datasets. I'm... pretty sure the people on the contract are tracking my revisions. They're planting errors in the data. I think they're trying to make it look like I can't handle the work. 

My wife and the junior analysts... they keep saying it's just version-control mistakes. But... I don't know. It doesn't feel like that.
How long have you been thinking that the people on the contract are tracking your revisions and planting errors in the data?
Well... about two months, I suppose. That's when I became certain they were doing it.
Have you been feeling like anyone else is out to get you or harm you in any way?
No... no, it's just the contract. I don't... I don't really know why anyone else would care about what I do.
Do you think it's possible that the errors in the data might be due to version-control mistakes, like your wife and the junior analysts suggest?

I... no. I don't think so. 

I know what my wife and the analysts say, but... it just doesn't make sense. The errors are... they're planted. It's being done on purpose to make it look like I can't lead the work. 

So... no. I don't think it's just a mistake.
How certain are you that the errors in the data are being planted on purpose?

I'm... I'm pretty sure. 

It's that environmental modeling contract. I've been watching the datasets. They track my revisions and... they put the errors there to make it look like I can't lead the work. 

So... yes. I'm certain.
Have you ever considered the possibility that you might be mistaken about the people on the contract planting errors in the data?

I... I know what my wife says. And the junior analysts. They keep telling me it's just version-control mistakes. But... I'm the one looking at the datasets. 

I can see them tracking my revisions. They're planting those errors so it looks like I can't lead the work. So... no. I don't think I'm mistaken.
Has thinking about the people on the contract planting errors in the data been interfering with your ability to do your job or interact with your family?

I... well, work has been difficult. I've fallen far enough behind on the deliverables that the firm reassigned pieces of the contract. And... I'm not really useful to the junior analysts I'm supposed to supervise right now. 

At home... I mostly just keep to myself. My wife has had to push me lately, just to keep basic routines going. So... yes, I suppose it has.
Have you been having any other thoughts that might seem unusual or hard to understand to others?
I... no. Not really. Just... just what we talked about with the contract. That's all.
Have you stopped doing anything you normally enjoy because of your concerns about the contract?

I... yes. I suppose so. I don't... I don't really do much of anything anymore. 

I used to like hiking. And going to the astronomy nights. Mentoring the younger guys at work. But lately... I just sit. Sometimes I'm at my desk for hours. Or out in the garage... the telescope is right there, still covered. I know I used to like it, but... I just don't feel the pull to start it. Or to talk to anyone, really.
Do you think the people on the contract are trying to harm you in a way that's unique or unusual, something that doesn't normally happen to others?

Harm me? I... no. I don't think so. 

It's just... it's just the data. They're planting the errors in the data. I haven't... I don't know about anything else. Just that.
Have you been avoiding social interactions or meetings at work because of your concerns about the contract?

I... yes. I suppose. I've fallen pretty far behind on the modeling deliverables... so much that the firm actually reassigned pieces of the contract to other people. I just don't... I've stopped being useful to the junior analysts I'm supposed to supervise. So I stay away. 

And at home... I mostly just keep to myself. My wife... she has to push me just to keep basic routines going right now. So, yes.
Do you think the belief that the people on the contract are planting errors in the data is something that most people would understand and agree with?

I... no. I don't think they do. 

My wife... she tells me it's just version-control mistakes. The junior analysts, they say the same thing. They think I'm just confused about the software. But... I know what I'm seeing. They're tracking my revisions. Planting the errors. They want to make it look like I can't lead the work anymore. But... no one else seems to see it that way.
Have you had any other thoughts that you're completely sure of, but that others might find hard to believe, outside of what's going on with the contract?
No. I... I don't think so. Just the data. There's nothing else.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't believe the people on the contract were planting errors in the data?
I... yes, before. But for the last two months... that's when I've been certain about it. The tracking, the errors... it's been about two months.
Have you ever had any other thoughts that you were completely sure of, but that others found hard to believe?
I thought you just asked me that. No. Just the contract. That's all.
Is your belief about the people on the contract planting errors in the data part of a larger idea or plan that you think is being carried out against you?
No. I don't know what you mean by a larger plan. It's... it's just the data. That's all I've seen.
Have you done anything differently in response to your belief that the people on the contract are planting errors in the data?
No. I... I just keep doing my job. Running the numbers. I haven't changed anything.
Have you ever had a time in the last two months when you didn't believe the people on the contract were planting errors in the data?

No... I mean, why would I? It's been happening. I know they've been tracking my revisions. It's why I'm even here... my wife and the junior analysts keep saying it's just, you know, version-control mistakes. But I know they're planting those errors. They want it to look like I can't lead the work. So... no, I haven't stopped believing it.
Have you ever had a moment in the last two months where you doubted that the people on the contract were planting errors in the data?
I... I thought I just answered that. No. I don't have any reason to doubt it.
